name: EDCI 4210W
title: Instruction and Curriculum in the Secondary School
description: A study of the selection and organization of learning experiences, instructional materials and teaching methods. Course activities will include a combination of lecture, seminar, and clinical experiences in local schools.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open only to students in the Integrated Bachelor's/Master's Teacher Prep Program.
